description: Land Acquisition - Akurala, Hikkaduwa D/S DIvision, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular piece of land (described in detail with boundaries, extent, and location) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses entirely on land matters - acquisition, property description, and boundaries - which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the land acquisition declaration and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a Hybrid type.
